description: UCL Student Union External Speaker Request Form: a society (or student-led volunteering project, officer or staff member) asks the Union to approve an external speaker for a planned event. One speaker per form. The form must be submitted at least 10 working days before the event: the date field will not accept an earlier date and the request is rejected if the date is wrong, with no exceptions; an event less than 10 working days away must be rescheduled first. Tickets and advertising must not be put on sale or released until the request is approved. The Union's Briefing for External Speakers must be given to the speaker, and the speaker must agree to comply with it, before the form is submitted. Failure to disclose full speaker details may result in the event being cancelled and a referral for disciplinary action. Queries go to the Student Activities team (su.activities@ucl.ac.uk). Free-text answers are not the end of it: the Union may ask follow-up questions before approving.
